subject.title: Slug alias quota (25) blocking legitimate naming migration — publisher nitishgargiitd

question: After verifying the authenticated owner of publisher nitishgargiitd, should staff prune selected low-use aliases or authorize a one-time quota exception for the 13 listed renames?
rationale: Aliases preserve installation and link compatibility, while the quota protects namespace and abuse boundaries; source inspection cannot determine which redirects are safe to remove or whether an exception is appropriate.

options.title: Audit and migrate
options.body: Verify ownership and alias usage, then apply the smallest guarded combination of low-use alias retirement and one-time exception needed for the migration.

options.title: Prune aliases only
options.body: Require the publisher to identify disposable redirects and keep the global quota unchanged without an exception.

options.title: Raise publisher quota
options.body: Grant this publisher a higher durable quota, accepting the additional namespace and operational exposure.

recommendation.title: Audit and migrate
recommendation.body: Verify ownership and alias usage, then apply the smallest guarded combination of low-use alias retirement and one-time exception needed for the migration.
